## Summary

Describe the change and why it is needed.

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Feature / enhancement
- [ ] UI / design system update (EN + FR locales verified)
- [ ] Documentation / runbook update
- [ ] Infrastructure / CI / packaging

## Checklist

- [ ] `python scripts/auto_ci.py` passes locally
- [ ] New or updated user-facing strings are added to both `locale/en.json` and `locale/fr.json`
- [ ] If Markdown docs were edited, `python scripts/md_to_html.py` was run and `docs/*.html` changes are committed
- [ ] No secrets, tokens, or local DuckDB files are included
